title: How to Protect Your Investments at Zero Cost
description:
Learn how to protect your portfolio from the next market downturn using the Protective Collar strategy. In this week's Growth Lab, Tony Zhang breaks down how investors and advisors can generate income while limiting downside exposure during uncertain market conditions.

You'll learn:
- How collars work in real-world portfolios
- When and why protection becomes more valuable late in a market cycle
- How to structure collars to balance income, protection, and flexibility
- How to manage and adjust positions as conditions change

This session is designed for investors who want to stay invested while reducing vulnerability to sharp market declines.

26:17 – Exit Rules & Managing the Strategy
